---
title: "Live supplementary reference reconciliation"
format: html
---

Read-only planning from a verified live snapshot. Writes local plans, never the
manuscript. Browser Suggesting mode is required to apply each exact unique match.

```{python}
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment')
out=root/'PRJEB79569/derived/supplementary_reference_reconciliation_2026-09-22'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
text=(root/'PRJEB79569/derived/manuscript_snapshot_2026-09-22_overnight_start/accepted_preview.txt').read_text()
pre=[
('Our combined non-redundant MAG-vOTU catalogue recruited an average of 87.76% and 96.78% of MG and MT reads respectively indicating that our de novo assembled catalogue is highly representative of the community (Supplementary Table S22).', 'Coassembly mapped-alignment fractions ranged from 78.05–88.49% for MG and 95.77–97.58% for MT. These fractions include secondary alignment records; catalogue-assigned counts are reported separately (Supplementary Table S22).'),
('Per -MAG/-vOTU quality metrics and taxonomic assignments are provided in Supplementary Tables S1, S2 and S6.', 'Per-MAG and per-vOTU quality metrics and taxonomic assignments are provided in Supplementary Tables S1 and S2.'),
('4,005 downregulated in treatment (FIG; Supplementary Table S8).','4,005 downregulated in treatment (Supplementary Table S8).'),
('Cycle-level comparison showed 1 and 11 significantly expressed features at FDR ≤ 0.05, respectively, in cycles 2 and 3 (FIG; Supplementary Table S8).','Treatment-by-cycle contrasts identified 1 and 11 genes whose treatment–control differences changed in cycles 2 and 3, respectively, relative to cycle 1 (FDR (BH) ≤ 0.05; Supplementary Table S8).'),
('CRISPR-mediated phage interaction evidence (Figure 2) to finalise the list (Table 1).','CRISPR-mediated phage interaction evidence (Figure 2; Supplementary Table S7) to finalise the list (Table 1).'),
('with paired-end adapter detection enabled and a minimum retained read length of 36 bases.','with paired-end adapter detection enabled and a minimum retained read length of 36 bases. Software versions and key parameters are listed in Supplementary Table S28.'),
('Detailed information available in Supplementary Tables S17 and S18.','Score inputs, candidate fits, suppression scenarios and the all-MAG comparison are provided in Supplementary Tables S16–S19.'),
('membranes, which is the application of high-pressure back washes to remove biofilms built up in the membrane (Figure S1).','membranes, which is the application of high-pressure back washes to remove biofilms built up in the membrane (Supplementary Figure S1).'),
('experiment described in Supplementary Figure 1.','experiment described in Supplementary Figure S1.'),
('i)main design, ~ phase + cycle + condition, estimating  the treatment vs control DEGs adjusting for phase and cycle ii) the interaction design, ~ phase + cycle * condition, to estimate cycle-2 and cycle-3 differences from the cycle-1. The interaction model tested whether differences in gene expression between treatment and control at cycles 2 and 3 differed from those at cycle 1, adjusting for sampling phase.', 'i) the main design, ~ phase + cycle + condition, estimating treatment–control differences adjusted for phase and cycle; and ii) the interaction design, ~ phase + cycle * condition, testing whether treatment–control differences changed in cycles 2 and 3 relative to cycle 1, adjusted for phase.'),
('). . Genes were retained','). Genes were retained'),
('across all samples. , and the phase- and cycle-adjusted design. Library composition','across all samples. Library composition'),
]
plan=[]
for old,new in pre:
    assert text.count(old)==1,(old,text.count(old))
    # Match a heading without its newline so Google Find remains single-line.
    if old.endswith('\n'):
        old=old.rstrip('\n');new=new.rstrip('\n')
    plan.append({'old':old,'new':new,'kind':'comment_correction'})
    text=text.replace(old,new,1)
pat=r'Supplementary Tables? S\d+(?:(?:[–-]|, | and )S?\d+)*'
def nums(s):
    result=[]
    for token in re.findall(r'S?\d+(?:[–-]S?\d+)?',s):
        z=[int(v) for v in re.findall(r'\d+',token)]
        result.extend(range(z[0],z[-1]+1))
    return result
order=[]
for m in re.finditer(pat,text):
    for n in nums(m.group()):
        if n not in order:order.append(n)
assert set(order)==set(range(1,29)),order
mapping={n:i+1 for i,n in enumerate(order)}
def label(ns):
    ns=sorted(ns);groups=[];i=0
    while i<len(ns):
        j=i
        while j+1<len(ns) and ns[j+1]==ns[j]+1:j+=1
        if j-i>=2:groups.append(f'S{ns[i]}–S{ns[j]}')
        else:groups.extend(f'S{x}' for x in ns[i:j+1])
        i=j+1
    joined=groups[0] if len(groups)==1 else ', '.join(groups[:-1])+' and '+groups[-1]
    return 'Supplementary Table'+('s' if len(ns)>1 else '')+' '+joined
refplan=[]
matches=list(re.finditer(pat,text))
for mi,m in enumerate(matches):
    replacement=label([mapping[n] for n in nums(m.group())])
    if replacement==m.group():continue
    # Exact context around each occurrence prevents cascading old/new numbers.
    a=max(text.rfind('\n',0,m.start())+1,m.start()-35)
    b=m.end()
    if mi:a=max(a,(matches[mi-1].end()+m.start()+1)//2)
    if mi+1<len(matches):b=min(b,(m.end()+matches[mi+1].start())//2)
    e=text.find('\n',m.end());b=min(b,e) if e>=0 else b
    old=text[a:b];new=text[a:m.start()]+replacement+text[m.end():b]
    assert text.count(old)==1,(old,text.count(old))
    refplan.append({'old':old,'new':new,'kind':'table_reference','old_reference':m.group(),'new_reference':replacement})
for p in refplan:
    assert text.count(p['old'])==1,p
    text=text.replace(p['old'],p['new'],1)
plan+=refplan
(out/'browser_plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
(out/'mapping.json').write_text(json.dumps({'old_to_new':mapping,'old_numbers_in_new_order':order},indent=2))
(out/'planned_projection.txt').write_text(text)
print('Planned',len(plan),'unique edits; map',mapping)
```
